# Private checked font-reader patterns

Modifications Copyright (c) 2026, Jiaqi (0x7c13) Liu. Original fontations source remains under its original licenses.

This fork adds explicit request control to the actual borrowed readers used by the Notepads font consumers. FontData remains Copy and FontRef remains Clone; neither stores an allocator, account or hidden thread-local state. A checked view is not an owner of its source font bytes. The consumer must keep the original admitted font owner and FontKey/data binding alive.

`control::{TryFontRead,TryFontReadWithArgs,TryComputeSize,TryVarSize}` are sealed. The outside Result transports the original WorkControl error; the inside Result is the original ReadError or PostScript Error. The only default reader bridge is TryFontRead to TryFontReadWithArgs for unit Args. There is no T:FontRead ordinary parser bridge into checked execution. Ordinary external reader/provider/context APIs remain available only through NoControl adapters in the shared kernels.

Generated constructors are explicitly registered with simple_table_read, format_table_read or args_table_read. Their original MIN_SIZE, discriminant branches, copied Args and field construction remain in the sole shared body. The hand-written borrowed Tuple, VariationRegion, InstanceRecord, Loca and U16Or32 readers use the same pattern. A registered constructor is not a claim that every accessor on that type is checked.

Dynamic generated ranges must propagate the outside error before recovering an inside font error. Avar axis_segment_maps is a concrete example: Avar::read is constant-size, but its accessor calls SegmentMaps::try_total_len_for_count and checks every variable record. Nullable offsets keep null, font error, cursor EOF and control failure separate. Checked cursors offer try_next rather than an ordinary Iterator escape. Arrays and offsets select the same mode-restricted primitive kernels in both paths.

CheckedFontRef binds TryTableProvider to one original request. Its ordinary TableProvider/Deref escape is absent. Checked top-level helpers resolve hhea/vhea/head before the same metrics/loca readers. Font directories preserve the original sorted/binary or unsorted/first-match algorithms. Pure scalar binary searches have explicit prepaid bounded comparison windows; no comparator resolves another reader, allocates or invokes a host callback. Checked CFF INDEX arithmetic proves generated ranges and sizes before entering the original scalar kernel; malformed extents are font OutOfBounds, not a resource quota.

Fvar normalization retains the original 64-axis inline arrays and fixed/floating arithmetic. Ordinary spills are Vec; request spills are BudgetVec on the same ResourcesRef. Initialization, scans and output conversion are checked before bounded work. Each natural scratch owner is destroyed before its subsequent consumer gate. A failed release remains an unrefunded diagnostic state and prevents successful publication; it is not reported as a successful refund.

Glyf point/coordinate scans, component scans, gvar tuple selection, each raw axis including ignored zero peaks, packed point prescans, delta count/skip/end and dense/sparse accumulation use the original algorithms with explicit control. Copy view clones do not allocate. Only the audited built-in TupleDelta constructors can be returned through the checked delta cursor. The legitimate repeat255 case uses an internal u16 count to represent256 points while still decoding exactly one u8 repeat byte. A zero-point fast decode validates the empty output lengths and succeeds without indexing trailing flags/padding.

PostScript DICT and charstring execution use one algorithm per original operation. Every token, operand scan, subroutine/seac lookup and no-pen loop is checked. BCD additionally checks before every encoded byte (two nibbles), including FontMatrix's dynamic-scaling second pass. The sealed context's ordinary external callback adapter exists only for NoControl; RequestCffContext accepts the original CFF bytes/indices/request. A callback's same-slot failure is checked immediately before the next sink action or fallback. Declared request depth termination is typed QuotaWork at the original guard; ordinary error behavior remains separate. Normal font recovery or NoMatch is not turned into resource failure.

VARC readers control each actual component, including long packed axis-value count/skip, and expose borrowed condition views for the consumer's explicit short-circuit frame traversal. These reader APIs do not implement or qualify the higher-level skrifa VARC traversal, ColorGlyph interpreter, hinting engine, Harfrust checked facade, complete SVG budgets, Native libraries or product packages.

The published crate does not contain font-codegen's full source. This change edits actual generated output and records the concrete patterns here; it does not claim regeneration or upstream generator modification. Future regeneration must reapply these explicit registrations and dynamic-accessor patterns and repeat the fixed upstream fixtures and controlled fault tests. Existing expected data and original tests must not be regenerated to hide differences.
